title: Tencent Releases Hy-Nomas Video World Model and Interaction Benchmark
summary:
The latest generative tool from Tencent's Hunyuan division supports multi-turn text and camera control while producing 720p video output at 24 FPS. The new model, called Hy-Nomas, is available under an Apache 2.0 license and utilizes KV cache memory for continuous generation, with an inference option compatible with a single RTX 4090.

Alongside the model, the company published Hy-Nomas-Bench on Hugging Face to provide a standardized method for evaluating controllable video world models. The benchmark includes 280 test cases focused on spatial memory, interleaved control and camera navigation.
